findings.issue: Common noun מָסַךְ (H4539, singular construct) is left untranslated as masaj; a non-name lemma must be Spanish.
Column suffix is 3rd masculine singular and base suffix is 3rd feminine singular; both appear as gender-neutral sus, so that possessor distinction is not visible.
שַׁעַר is inside a construct chain made definite by הֶחָצֵר, while puerta has no article.

notes: Object markers stay untranslated; plurals, singulars, and both conjunctions match.
